pure-announcement.rationale: A configuration-level how-to on Collector sampling strategies, not a launch or funding notice; the vendor byline is incidental to vendor-neutral OTel content.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept touches telemetry sampling or pipeline cost control; the closest, slo-burn-rate-alerting, is about alerting policy, not data reduction.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every strategy ships as a runnable Collector config and the savings claims are measurable via the collector's own accepted/sent span metrics.

durability.rationale: Tail-versus-head sampling, keep-errors/keep-slow policy shapes, cardinality trimming and validate-after-each-change are mechanisms and trade-offs that outlive the illustrative 80-90% figures.

actionability.rationale: A reader can lift the four processor configs, the four-point validation checklist and the roll-out-one-strategy-at-a-time ordering directly into any OTel pipeline.

atomicity.rationale: Everything serves one statable idea — decide telemetry fidelity at the Collector before storage, keeping all errors and slow traces while sampling the routine rest.
